property_summary: Once the contract is Initialized, SetLogFile must always revert (the initialization lock is permanent); the mutant deletes the guard so a later SetLogFile succeeds and silently swaps the log target, breaking the rule for any address input.
change_summary: Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so SetLogFile can still change the LogFile address after initialization, altering which log contract receives subsequent AddMessage calls.
